plan.understanding: Yale AI Club is asking for 20 navy hoodies, size M, with a bulk discount. The linked stock row shows 8 size M available, leaving a shortfall of 12; inventory must establish restock options and costs before accounting evaluates any purchase or discount. Current cash is $3,400.00, with $3,240.00 in open invoice and near-term rent obligations, leaving $160.00 after them; those obligations and pending requests on tickets 101 and 102 compete for cash.

steps.task: For SKU CC-HOOD-NAVY, size M, qty 20, verify available stock and the 12-unit shortfall; identify feasible substitutes if any, restock vendor, unit cost, lead_days/arrival from shop date, and any vendor open-invoice shipment blocker. Provide stock-based discount considerations, without promising a price or date.
steps.deliverable: Confirmed available/shortfall quantities; substitute options; restock vendor, cost and lead-time/arrival facts; blocker status; stock-based discount view and any data gaps.

steps.task: Using inventory's findings, check unit cost and margin at any candidate discount prices against the 40% policy floor; assess affordability against cash and obligations, noting existing approval requests on tickets 101/102. If a purchase order or discount is viable and warranted, check the approval board first and file only the needed request(s), using tool-derived amounts; do not duplicate the invoice-payment request already pending on ticket 101.
steps.deliverable: Margin/policy calculation, liquidity and competing-obligation assessment, any request IDs and exact amounts filed, or reason no request is safe/appropriate.

success_criteria: Owner receives a clear, data-supported decision on whether a 20-unit offer can be fulfilled and what stock action is needed.
Any proposed discount is at or above the 40% margin floor unless explicitly identified as a human-only policy exception; no price or date is promised.
Any payment or purchase request is human-approved before execution, uses database-derived amounts, and does not duplicate an existing request.
Cash does not go negative; rent and the overdue invoice remain visible as competing obligations.
risks_to_watch: Only 8 size M hoodies are on hand, so 12 are needed beyond current stock.
Cash after the $840.00 overdue invoice and $2,400.00 rent obligations is $160.00; pending requests on tickets 101/102 must be accounted for, and new discretionary spend may be unaffordable.
A vendor with an open unpaid invoice cannot ship new product; confirm whether the relevant vendor is blocked.
Customer is awaiting a response, but no unapproved price, discount, or arrival date may be promised.
No existing ticket-specific approval request is listed for ticket 103; avoid duplicating requests recorded under another ticket.

report.summary: Verified 8 size-M CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies are on hand, so the 20-unit request is short by 12 and cannot be filled as specified now. facts.statement: Shop date: 2026-08-31.
CC-HOOD-NAVY size M on hand: 8; needed: 20; shortfall: 12; cannot fill now; location Aisle A.
Other sizes of this hoodie: S 4, L 14, XL 6; these are possible size-mix substitutes only with customer agreement.
Size-M restock estimate: 12 units at unit cost $22.00; total cost $264.00.

Bulldog Print Co is specialty-matched by apparel reprint (vendor/SKU link is not in the database); lead time is 5 days, but it cannot ship now because invoice 501 for $840.00 is overdue, due 2026-08-28 by 3 days.
No arrival date is available while blocked; vendor timing is payment date + 5 days.
Hoodie stock snapshot: 32 units total; 8 are size M; stock value at cost $704.00. The snapshot reports no sold-out sizes for this SKU.
The only other apparel SKU shown is CC-TEE-WHITE, with 10 units total; it is a different product, not an equivalent hoodie substitute.

recommendations: Accounting: treat the 12-unit, $264.00 hoodie restock as unavailable until invoice 501 is resolved; any purchase-order request should account for this blocker and be submitted only through the approval process.
Customer Service: ask whether the group would accept a size mix from the 8 M plus other available hoodie sizes; do not assume acceptance or promise a delivery date.

Accounting: assess any bulk discount only against the order actually feasible (size-M quantity vs an agreed size mix) and the verified cost floor; inventory does not recommend a discount to move excess size-M stock.
for_boss: A human/accounting decision is needed on whether to resolve overdue invoice 501 to unblock the possible restock; payment would not itself be an order or a customer delivery promise.
data_gaps: The database has no SKU-to-vendor mapping; Bulldog Print Co is matched by its apparel-reprint specialty, not a confirmed SKU relationship.
Because the vendor is blocked, the database cannot provide an arrival date; it would be payment date plus the 5-day lead time.
No sales history, sell-through rate, receiving dates, or customer acceptance of alternate sizes is available.
substitutes: Same hoodie in alternate sizes: S (4), L (14), XL (6); could potentially use up to 20 units total when combined with the 8 M, if the customer accepts a size mix.
CC-TEE-WHITE is another apparel item but a different product, with 10 units total; it should only be offered as an alternative if the customer considers it acceptable.
report.discount_view: Stock argues against treating this as a discount to clear size-M overstock: only 8 M are available for a 20-unit request, and the 12-unit restock is blocked pending invoice 501. Current other-size stock could support a mixed-size option if the customer agrees, but any price decision is for Accounting and human approval.

report.summary: Verified the hoodie economics and cash position: the 40% policy-floor benchmark is $36.67 per hoodie, but no customer price was specified, and only 8 of the requested 20 size-M units are on hand. After paying the overdue invoice, cash would be $2,560.00; after rent as well, $160.00 remains, or $152.00 after the pending $8.00 PO. The additional $264.00 restock would put cash at -$112.00 if all those outflows proceed.
CC-HOOD-NAVY unit cost is $22.00; list price is $58.00 and list-price margin is 62.1%.

At the 40% policy floor, the benchmark price is $36.67 per unit (36.8% off list), with a $733.40 total and $293.40 gross profit for 20 units; the evaluated margin is 40.0%, within policy and above cost.
Ticket 103 requests 20 size-M hoodies; linked stock shows 8 size M on hand, a shortfall of 12.

recommendations: Prioritize human review of pending request ID 1 for overdue invoice 501, then ID 3 for rent due 2026-09-02; note the pending ticket-101 PO ID 2 also uses $8.00.

Do not file the ticket-103 PO: inventory reports a $264.00 replenishment blocked until invoice 501 is paid, and available liquidity after existing obligations and the pending $8.00 PO is only $152.00.

Do not file a discount request now. Treat $36.67 as the in-policy floor benchmark only; first clarify a proposed price and whether the customer accepts a size mix or a later fulfillment plan. No customer price or delivery promise is approved.
for_boss: Ticket 103 has no discount price supplied, and 12 of the requested size-M units are unavailable. Human/customer decision is needed on whether to pursue an alternate-size mix and whether to resolve invoice 501; paying that invoice does not itself approve a restock or commit a delivery date.

Do not duplicate pending invoice-payment request ID 1. No new request was filed for ticket 103 because the restock is blocked and unaffordable against obligations, and a discount quote cannot yet be tied to feasible fulfillment.

final.recommended_outcome: The request cannot be fulfilled as specified now: 8 size-M hoodies are available against 20 requested, a shortfall of 12. The possible 12-unit restock costs $264.00, is blocked by overdue invoice 501, and is unaffordable after the $840.00 invoice and $2,400.00 rent obligations plus the pending $8.00 PO. customer_drafts.subject: Your navy hoodie request
customer_drafts.body:
Hello Yale AI Club,

Thanks for reaching out about 20 navy hoodies in size M and a bulk discount. I’m sorry, but we currently have only 8 in size M, so we can’t fulfill all 20 in that size right now. We’re confirming whether additional M hoodies can be made available and reviewing pricing; no restock date or discount is confirmed yet.

We do have other sizes of this hoodie available and could explore a mixed-size order if that might work for your group. Would you be open to a size mix? Please let us know your preferred sizes, and we’ll confirm what we can offer.

Best,
Campus Customs
